summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed indicator. In rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False) and a static render_speed() that scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix; render() shows speed for unknown totals when show_speed is on. track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables; task_total is declared Optional[float]. Tests: removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track and added test_task_progress_column_speed. CHANGELOG.md has the new Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions; those checks remain unverified.
